declarations.name: AuiChat

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the conversation log.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: Messages: { id, role, text, format?, timestamp?, author?, attachments?, status?, error?, feedback? }.

inputs.name: authors
inputs.description: Default author per role: { name, avatar?, icon? }.

inputs.name: suggestions
inputs.description: Suggestion chips above the composer: { id, label, text? } (hidden while streaming).

inputs.name: typing
inputs.description: Name of someone typing (people chats).

inputs.name: composer
inputs.description: Show the composer (Prompt Input).

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Composer options (placeholder, attachments, accept, triggers, counter, submitKey, ...).

inputs.name: emptyText
inputs.description: Text shown while there are no messages.

inputs.name: copyable
inputs.description: Copy action on user and assistant messages (and on code blocks).

inputs.name: feedback
inputs.description: Thumbs up and down on finished assistant messages.

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Names holidays and non-working days in the day separators.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Reference day for Today and Yesterday; default today in the timezone.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: assistantFormat
inputs.description: Format of assistant and tool messages that do not set format.

inputs.name: showTimestamps
inputs.description: Show times and day separators.

inputs.name: showAvatars
inputs.description: Show avatars next to messages.

inputs.name: maxRenderedMessages
inputs.description: Most messages in the DOM (integer 20..2000); earlier ones are behind Show earlier messages.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: Heading level of a Markdown # heading (integer 2..6).

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone of times and day separators.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of labels, times, and dates.

outputs.name: sent
outputs.description: The user sent a message or chose a suggestion: { text, attachments }; prevent it to keep the text and add no message.

outputs.name: stopped
outputs.description: A streaming reply was stopped (Stop or stop()): { id }.

outputs.name: retried
outputs.description: Retry on a failed or stopped reply: { id, prompt } (the user message before it).

outputs.name: feedbackGiven
outputs.description: The user rated a reply: { id, value: 'up' | 'down' | null }.

outputs.name: suggestionChosen
outputs.description: A suggestion chip was chosen: { suggestion }; prevent it to handle it yourself instead of sending its text.

outputs.name: attachmentOpened
outputs.description: An attachment chip was activated: { messageId, attachment }.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Append a message, or replace the message with the same id.

methods.name: removeMessage
methods.description: Remove a message (stops it when it is streaming).

methods.name: stream
methods.signature: stream(source: ChatStreamSource | ((signal: AbortSignal) => ChatStreamSource), init?: ChatStreamInit | undefined): Promise<ChatMessage> | undefined
methods.description: Stream a reply into a new or existing message; resolves with the final message (complete, stopped, or error).

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop the streaming reply; emits aui-stop.

methods.name: scrollToLatest
methods.description: Scroll to the newest message and follow new content again.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the composer (or the log without one).

accessibility.pattern: Log (WAI-ARIA role=log) of messages as articles, with a polite live region announcement per finished message; the composer is a labelled multi-line text field.

limitations: The DOM keeps at most maxRenderedMessages messages (default 200); earlier ones are added back in steps by 'Show earlier messages'. The list is not virtualized.
The Markdown subset has no tables, images, task lists, or HTML; nested lists follow indentation of two or more spaces.
Code blocks are shown as text without syntax highlighting.
Announcements read the first 300 characters of a finished reply.
